data.description: Contract-first per sequence/sidebar-fold-tickets.md §T2, then build. New organizer-only delete route with the cascade enumerated in SPEC: dies — submissions (both kinds), forms + public links, agenda slots, published pages, portal magic links, queued outbox mail + calendar invites, event embeds; survives — people, notes, tags, org-level attachment subjects (do not deepen the attachments.event_id wart), audit log (deletion audited with actor). Unify with the existing remove-demo verb (SPEC Amendment 19) rather than forking. AC mint: type-the-conference-name confirm gate; dies/stays disclosure in the dialog; post-delete landing (another conference if one exists, else fresh-install landing); irreversibility. Build: Danger zone card at the foot of Conference settings + modal per prototype (wrong name stays locked — tested both ways); CLI verb + skill-file mention for agent-native parity. Design contract: prototypes/pipeline-v1.1 settings view (v1.15).
